title: Sustainable recovery of bioactive compounds from Nelumbo nucifera using ultrasound-assisted extraction optimized through response surface methodology
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1517-1528
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00250H, Paper
Open Access

Thiti Sonphakdi, Mohammad Fikry, Saranya Jansamutr, Kitipong Assatarakul
This study details the optimization of ultrasound assisted extraction from lotus flowers. The potent antioxidant activities are revealed, and the thermodynamic properties of the process are analyzed.
